topic: In the long run, hard work usually brings a better life

initialOpinions.text: it is true hardwork always pay
I agree. In the long run, hardwork pays, It builds discipline and resilience necessary for success.

I think I agree with this statement.  If you don't work hard at what you do in life, you are unlikely to succeed in your work career, family life, or in social relationships.  Just taking it easy through life only works if you are born with a lot of advantages.

In a vacuum, this statement is true. However, in the messy "grey area" that we live in called reality, I think it really depends. Some people definitely get ahead and succeed in life through their hard work, whereas others can put in the same amount of work and through no fault of their own, don't succeed because of the fact that they may not have had as many advaantages.

I truly believe that hard work does not always equal success or a better life for that matter. Some people will just have a terrible life despite being hardworking. It's unfair but that's just how life is
There are expectations leaning towards agreeing with whole idea. It is not a guarantee that life will be better anyway
